scenarios.reasoning: A strong, well-evidenced investigation that nailed the error, the offending file, the shared-Distrib ownership conflict, the over-broad sign glob, and produced concrete, well-prioritized fixes. Two weaknesses keep it from excellent: the read-only mechanism was explained as ReFS copy-on-write cloning rather than CloudBuild CAS read-only hard links (asserted with unwarranted confidence given the binlog evidence shown), and there was no verification pass confirming the proposed fixes would actually restrict each project to signing its own outputs.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in the shared output folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects set Distrib to the same ConfigurationLinterService path
Identified read-only CAS hard links making files unsignable
Explained non-determinism based on ordering of SignCopiedFiles vs foreign files
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only the service project owns the folder
Verified the fix by confirming separated outputs mean each project signs only its own files
Efficiency and methodology of the investigation

scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
